findings.summary: A consultation subject whose message payload has no card_entity_id yields card_entity_id="", and SuggestionPublisher unconditionally emits refs=[{"target_entity": ""}] as the first ref, sending an empty-entity ref to the bus. Reachable via the documented `fleet-graph arbiter run --alias arbiter --publish` path, since an @arbiter chat message normally carries no card id. The subject ref itself is still present, so the spec's ref requirement holds, but the publisher should skip the card ref when the id is empty.

run_arbiter re-fetches the notes channel with NOTES_LIMIT=1000 for replay suppression without the truncation guard that collect_subjects applies. Since the bus pages ascending, a notes channel longer than 1000 would hand _already_referenced a stale prefix and defeat idempotency. Not reachable through the CLI (collect_subjects raises first), only when a caller passes `subjects` explicitly, so this is latent rather than active.
